transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm just here because... my daughter thought I should come. It's just... whenever I get into one of those slow elevators, or a small room where the door locks behind you... my chest just jumps. Right away. I just get this really strong need to get out of there. Before I can even really think about it. It's just... uncomfortable, that's all.
Do you ever have these episodes of intense fear or discomfort that reach a peak within minutes?

Well... I don't know about reaching a peak, or anything like that. It's not really... I wouldn't call it intense fear. Just... like I said, I just don't like being stuck in there. It's just uncomfortable, that's all.
Are these uncomfortable feelings always triggered by being in enclosed or small spaces?

Yeah... pretty much. I mean... I know a little storage room or... an elevator down at the museum ain't the same as being locked up for real. But... I don't know, my mind just treats it like trouble. Soon as I see there's no window and the door shuts tight... that's when it gets to me.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of extreme fear or discomfort that seemed to come out of nowhere?
No... not out of nowhere. It's just... like I was saying, it's just when I'm in those small spaces. That's all.
Have you ever had a panic attack in one of these small or enclosed spaces?
No... nothing like that. I don't... I don't panic. Like I said, I just... I just want to get out of there, that's all.
Do you tend to avoid enclosed or small spaces because of the uncomfortable feelings you get in them?

Yeah, I guess so. I... I just take the stairs now. And I pass on any jobs down in the archives at the museum. If I absolutely have to go into a tight spot, I... I'll ask a friend to wait nearby. Makes me feel a bit foolish, but... it's just what I do.
Do you ever feel anxious or uncomfortable in situations that are not related to being in small or enclosed spaces?
No, not really. Just the small spaces. That's about it.
Are there any other situations, besides being in small or enclosed spaces, where you feel anxious or uncomfortable?
No. Like I just said, it's really only the small spaces. I don't... I don't really get worked up about anything else.
Are you ever anxious or uncomfortable when thinking about being in a small or enclosed space, even if you are not actually in one?
No... not really. I don't sit around thinking about it. Just... if I have to go in one, that's when it bothers me.
Do you worry about having these uncomfortable feelings in small spaces when you're not actually in one?
No. I don't... I don't worry about it ahead of time. It's just when I'm actually in a tight spot.
Do you think you would feel anxious or uncomfortable if you were in a small or enclosed space with someone you trust?
I don't know... I suppose so. Doesn't really matter who's there with me. It's the space itself.
Do you ever avoid planning to go into small or enclosed spaces because you're concerned about how you'll feel when you're in them?
No, I don't really... plan around it. I just deal with it if it happens.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable in other situations that are similar to being in small spaces, but not actually in one, such as watching a movie about someone trapped in a small room?
No... can't say that I do. It's just a movie, so... doesn't bother me none.
Do you feel anxious when you think about the possibility of being trapped in a small space in the future?
Not really. I don't spend much time thinking about things that haven't happened yet.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable when you are in a situation where you might potentially be trapped or unable to leave, even if you are not in a small physical space?
No... not really. If I ain't in a tight spot, it don't cross my mind.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable when you think about being in a small space, but are not actually in one, if someone describes it to you?
No, I don't reckon I do. Just hearing about it ain't the same as being in one, so... no, doesn't bother me.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable when you are approaching or anticipating being in a small or enclosed space?
I suppose... maybe a little. If I know I gotta go into some cramped little room or something, I might get a bit uneasy right before. But... I don't make a big fuss over it.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable when you are thinking about an upcoming situation where you will be in a small or enclosed space?
Not really. I don't sit around thinking about it beforehand. Just... deal with it when it happens, I guess.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable when you think about being in a small space before you actually enter it?
No... like I was just saying, not really. I don't stand around thinking about it before I go in. Just... go in and get it over with, I suppose.
